note: Issue #880: the red system's asteroid field, a place on the field type (content/core/planets/types.json 'field'): no ground, open space's dark sky, a few hundred rocks round a small dock town on the biggest of them. Low gravity everywhere (the field landmark's gravity, as the cruiser's outside: content/core/cruiser/remnant_cruiser.json), your feet stick to the rock under you and you fall toward the nearest big one in reach; drift clear of them all and you are pulled back to your ship. Three wrecked cruisers to walk into among the rocks, four Remnant outposts (skimmer outposts, content/core/stations/skimmer_outpost.json) on the biggest rocks as a Territory front ('field'), and jobs on the station's bar board (content/core/board/bar_board.json: the field jobs).

landmarks.note: The field itself (src/systems/world/field_rocks.gd; run by src/systems/world/field_world.gd). gravity: m/s/s on foot anywhere out here; jet_recharge: seconds of jetpack fuel a second back in the air (after its usual pause). jump_m: how high a jump rises out here (the same push as anywhere: 0.6 m at home's 20 m/s/s is 3 m at 4), so a run and a jump carries you over to the next rock. reach: how far past a rock's face its pull holds (plus 0.4 of its radius), so you fall toward the nearest rock in reach. leap_m: in the air off a rock, that rock counts this many metres further off, so the next rock in reach takes you once you are off its face (PlanetSphere.body_bias). drift_s and drift_m: clear of every rock's reach for drift_s seconds, or drift_m metres below the deck, and you are pulled back to your ship. home: the dock rock under the deck (scale: of the deck's half width; face_y: its flat top, under the deck's keel slab). outpost_rocks: under each outpost (its 'station' landmark), in the station's own frame: its tower and its bay. path_radius and gap: the hops out to each outpost, wreck pad and the pilot's rock (rock radius, metres between faces). scatter: more rocks in that box (min x y z, max x y z) and radius range. small: the rocks you only see (no collision), tumbling. wrecks: posed like the belt's (BeltWrecks): at is the middle of the pad you come in on, yaw_deg the stern's heading from +z, pitch_deg its bow's dive (always down: the wreck's decks are built for a dive), roll_deg its list, variant as the belt wrecks' (StarcruiserWreck.VARIANT_KEYS; deck_drop for a shallow dive). sites: the stranded pilot's far rock and where the lost crate drifts. cells: where a salvage run's power cells lie in a wreck, in its interior's design frame (the droids' interior route). look: the rocks' colours and the jobs' things. wreck_names: what the jobs call each wreck. pilot_air_s: the stranded pilot's air from taking the job; dock_m: how near the dock your ship parks to bring them home. lines: what the field says (FieldWorld).
